  • Classes in org.apache.juneau.petstore.service used by org.apache.juneau.petstore.service
    Class
    Description
    AuditEntry
    One audit-trail record: who changed which petstore entity, how, and when.
    PendingChange
    One staged inline edit of a pet field, waiting on the Pending changes page to be applied or discarded.
    PendingChange.State
    Lifecycle of a staged change.
    PendingChanges
    The staging area for pet-detail inline edits: edits are staged here instead of mutating the pet, then applied (perRow, with retry on failure) or discarded (aggregate) from the Pending changes page.
    PendingChanges.DiscardOutcome
    Result of an aggregate discard, mapped 1:1 onto the console's BulkResult by ChangesRest.
    PendingChanges.Failure
    One failed id in a PendingChanges.DiscardOutcome.
